source: NIST X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy Database, NIST Standard Reference Database 20, Version 5.0 (A.V. Naumkin, A. Kraut-Vass, S.W. Gaarenstroom, C.J. Powell), https://srdata.nist.gov/xps/ ; records cited individually below. 'Powe10' = C.J. Powell, recommended Auger-electron kinetic energies for elemental solids (NIST SRD 20 records R-xx). Also ASTM E2108-00 Table 3 (after M.P. Seah, I.S. Gilmore, G. Beamson, Surf. Interface Anal. 26, 642 (1998)).
notes: Kinetic energies (eV) read via WebFetch 2026-10-15 from NIST SRD 20 pages SpectralByElm/<El>, XPSSummaryPage/<id>. Used only to cross-check the Avantage Auger kinetic energies; never written to the output. Elemental (metal) values unless noted; compound values shift by several eV.
